name: F_flatten_noLLM_v1
decision: Primary architecture = F (flatten head, no LLM). Evidence: S1 E vs F, ETTh1 H=96, alpha=0, seeds 42/123/456 under one protocol: F had lower test MSE on 3/3 seeds (0.3752 +- 0.0028 vs 0.3898 +- 0.0059; paired E-F +0.0082..+0.0209), lower validation MSE on 3/3 seeds, 5.2x less time per epoch (80 s vs 415 s on a T4) and 4.7x less GPU memory (1.84 vs 8.67 GB). E (GPT-2) is retained as a documented secondary variant, not used in the main study.

architecture.positional_embeddings: TD and FD, added once before self-attention

training.test_evaluation: once, after training, on the selected checkpoint

hardware: Kaggle, 2x Tesla T4 (one run per GPU)

metrics.primary: test RMSE (z-scored space, all windows x steps x variables)

supervisor_decision: Nov 1, 2026, Option 3: (1) verify E/F and run the 3-seed paired comparison [done: S1]; (2) freeze F as the efficient model for the main scheduler study unless the paired comparison gives a clear reason to choose E [none: F better on 3/3 seeds]; (3) full scheduler study on F with the calibrated fixed alpha as the critical comparator; (4) confirm the key scheduler result on E with paired seeds; (5) decide title, framing and claims from the evidence.
